purpose: Teach: 市議会/軽量/しくみ/持ち込み/冊子/薬剤師/値下げ/有識者

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 地元市議会、訪問、設定しろ。
lines.en: Schedule a visit to the local city council.
lines.style: Clipped, decisive. Minimal preamble. Low volume, efficient pace. The tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed without explanation. Direct eye contact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新型は軽量化が進んでいます。
lines.en: Understood. The new model is progressing well on weight reduction.
lines.style: Respectful but steady. Neither rushed nor obsequious. Clear enunciation on the key terms. Slight nod of acknowledgment. The cadence of a reliable report.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界のしくみ、若手にも教えろ。
lines.en: Make sure the younger staff understand how the industry operates.
lines.style: Measured directive. Light emphasis on 「younger」— not condescension, practical delegation. Calm, expectant tone. The manner of someone setting expectations, not micromanaging.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社外への持ち込み厳禁、徹底中です。
lines.en: Understood. We're enforcing strict protocols on external disclosure.
lines.style: Composed update, no apology in the tone. Factual and controlled. Slight pause before the second clause — showing the seriousness is being taken. Steady eye contact throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 紹介冊子、最新版に更新。
lines.en: Update the introductory materials to the latest version.
lines.style: Direct, final. Slight weight on the imperative. Brief, efficient phrasing. The tone assumes execution. Minimal elaboration — this is understood work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。薬剤師との連携、進めています。
lines.en: Understood. We're moving forward with coordination with our pharmacy partners.
lines.style: Calm acknowledgment of ongoing work. Slight pride in the update — this is progress being made. Steady pace, clear articulation. The tone of someone managing their responsibilities well.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 競合の値下げ、注視しろ。
lines.en: Monitor the competitors' price movements closely.
lines.style: Sharp, focused attention in the voice. Slight lean forward in the urgency. Low, deliberate pace on the directive word. The tone of someone who wants this to matter.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。有識者会議、来月、開催します。
lines.en: Understood. We'll convene the expert panel next month.
lines.style: Final confirmation, steady closure. No trailing-off — this is resolved. Composed, capable tone. The cadence of someone wrapping up a checklist with competence.
